changes: v3: the five books access levels of protocol §11b (spec runs/books-levels/school-books-access-spec.md) replace v2's viewers; a delay (not_yet) replaces open_period; rounding for public and member; cell rules by level and step; a PIN-locked variant from governance up; demo-only KPIs leave the series (MRR, ARR and churn are listed as not computed); suppressed cells read '—' and carry their reason; the mockup's invented 2024 and 2025, its daily split and its B4 Uni donors are carried into the fixtures
source: v2's KPI table, formats and labels; the mockup at 10ca2a6c1 (#115): BK_DEF, bkUnlock, bkPeriods, BK_SCALE, bkYear, bkAgg, cellWhy, bkRules, bkMakeDonors, bkDist, bkFundHtml, bkDays, bkCaption, bkSwitch, bkLock

rule.zeroIsExact: a cell whose value is 0 is shown exactly at every level; locked stays locked
rule.missingContrib: a contrib entry of null with a non-zero value is not_computed
rule.aggregate: a year or quarter cell passes the cell rule only if every month in it passes (conservative: the mart has monthly contrib only)
rule.complementary: in a period where the total is shown and exactly one term is suppressed, the smallest shown non-zero term is suppressed too
rule.derived: a derived cell is suppressed when an input is, locked when an input is, not_computed when an input is or its denominator is 0

steps.G1: Totals: one figure per period for the whole school
steps.G2: Categories: split by kind of money
steps.G3: Breakdowns: split by plan, programme or fund
steps.G4: Distributions: how amounts spread across people, with no rows
steps.G5: Per person, pseudonymous (never in a KPI document)
steps.G6: Identified (never in a KPI document; Reports 'Donors and payers', slice S5)

delay.rule: a period closes closeDays after its last day; it shows from that date plus the level's months for the KPI's lag class (money or usage); before that every cell of the class is not_yet. Periods after the clock's month are not in the document

rounding.rule: amount cells only, after the cell rule: sign(value) * round(|value| / roundTo) * roundTo; a positive value that rounds to 0 is { lt: roundTo }, shown 'under $1,000'; each period is rounded on its own (a year is not the sum of its rounded quarters); rates come from the exact sums; counts are exact

pinLocked.rule: the level's document with every amount cell, every rate whose rateOf is amount, and the day series locked; counts stay as the level shows them. The mockup shows only the PIN prompt until the PIN is entered

captions.aggregate: {Level} sees {grain}s, money rounded to {roundTo}, totals and categories only; cell rules on. {next}
captions.governance: Governance sees months, exact, from totals to how gifts spread, with plan and fund breakdowns and no names, emails or per-person rows. Cell rules are on for plans, funds and distributions. {next}
captions.full: {Level} sees everything, live: months and days, the open month included, names included. Cell rules are off, so no figure is hidden or banded. {ownerOnly}Every identified read is audited.
captions.ownerOnly: Owner-only actions (refunds, roles, publishing) stay on their own tabs.
captions.note: plain text (the mockup bolds the level name and 'no names, emails or per-person rows'); one caption per lag class, {next} names the first period of that class not shown yet

waiting.title: {label} is not shown yet
waiting.public.money: A year's money shows 12 months after the year closes.
waiting.public.usage: Usage shows once the year has closed.
waiting.member: A quarter shows once it has closed and one more quarter has passed.

policies.contrib: rule (a) and (b) on bundle.contrib[key][periodIndex] = [holders, largestShare], when the level's cell rules cover the KPI's step
policies.self: each unit is a distinct holder: passes when value is 0 or value >= 5
policies.derived: rule.derived; else the export's own value (months) or recomputed from the period's sums (years and quarters, 4 decimals like atm)
policies.blocked: always the blocked kind, for every level
policies.distribution: invented.donors, cumulative from January: a bucket or fund passes with at least 5 donors and none over 60% of its sum (the mockup's cellWhy); complementary within the buckets (by count) and within the funds (by sum); fewer than 5 donors in all hides the whole distribution and the median

reasons.complementary: hidden so the cell beside it can't be worked out from the total

kinds.rate: a fraction; rateOf says whether any input is an amount

credits_consumed.note: the provider rule of spec v3 2(b) is not applicable: the mart has no provider contrib

breakage_rate.note: atm returns 0 when credits_granted is 0; the adapter returns not_computed

donations_by_fund:*.source: invented.donors.funds, cumulative from January to the period's end

donors_median_gift.source: invented.donors, cumulative from January (mean of the two middle gifts when even)

notComputed.mrr: MRR is not computed: cash basis, a yearly payer counts in the month paid
notComputed.arr: ARR is not computed: cash basis
notComputed.churned_members: Churn is not computed: cash basis

complementary.rule: in a period where the total is shown and exactly one term is suppressed, suppress the next smallest shown term

aggregate.amountsAndEventCounts: sum of the period's months (up to the clock's month for real periods)
aggregate.max: paying_members: the most in one month of the period (the mockup's 'most in one month of')
aggregate.rates: recomputed from the period's summed inputs, rounded to 4 decimals like atm
aggregate.notComputed: arpa: needs distinct paying members per period

years.source: mockup BK_SCALE and bkYear: earlier years are invented from 2026's shape so the public view has something to show
years.rule: each 2026 month row of the preset times the year's factor, Math.round per month; rates recomputed; the month's contrib is 2026's; such periods carry invented: true

days.source: mockup bkDays: a month's gross spread over its days by weights 1 + (day0 * 7 + month0 * 3) mod 5, Math.round, the last day taking the remainder; the open month ends at the clock's day and later days are not_yet

donors.source: mockup bkMakeDonors for B4 Uni, the same for every preset (the snapshot has no donations: atm books no gifts and fact_payments holds membership payments only); amounts in cents; names are not carried (G6 is Reports, slice S5)

labels.blocked: Blocked: atm does not post renewal resets yet, so this balance goes negative

formats.money: Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: document.currency }) from integer minor units: 62300 USD -> $623.00, 62300 EUR -> €623.00
formats.money0: Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: document.currency, minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) from integer minor units: 400000 USD -> $4,000
